Integrated Splash Studio: Full-featured visual brand builder with Branded Logo and Artwork Fitter modes
High-DPI 960x640 Retina Canvas rendering pixel-perfect 480x320 startup screens
Interactive Startup Indicators: Loading Bar, Accent Ring, Pulsing Dots, and custom brand accents
Live Frameless Desktop Simulation with 1.5s startup fade animation test bench
1-Click Apply to Project: Auto-configures splash screen and matches window background color
Single-File Standalone Packaging: Bundles all 240+ .NET runtime DLLs directly into WebToExe.Studio.exe for a clean, zero-clutter root folder
Enterprise Security Hardening: AES-256 encrypted Studio container (studio.dat) with in-memory streaming
